sunoData.title: Lantern Market Hop
sunoData.tags: Chiptune-pop game music with buoyant midtempo swing, bouncy bass pulses, glockenspiel lead, and playful counter-melodies; verse-like loop opens on plucked synth and light hand percussion, then layers bright brass pops and sparkling arps for the main area theme, with a festive B-section that widens into full harmony before easing back to a smaller exploration loop. Add risers into transitions, coin-like chimes between phrases, and soft sidechain breathing. Crisp, glossy mix with a cheerful arcade shine., ambient, joyful, playful, bright
